visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for structural elements, border-red-500/50 for active/focus states
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows shadow-2xl or subtle drop-shadows on typography to ensure contrast
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay or dark carbon/leather texture to feel rugged, athletic and gritty

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous padding, p-6 to p-12 for distinct sections. Maintain strong negative space around hero typography.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Admin dashboard employs dense metric layouts, gap-4 to gap-6, maximizing viewable data without clutter.

motion.hover: Aggressive but smooth scale-up (scale-105) for cards, backgrounds shifting slightly lighter on interaction.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-ins and slide-ups for grid items, conveying energy and speed.

public_site.hero: 80vh to 100vh height. Massive 'Bebas Neue' text, striking primary CTA button. Image background with bg-black/50 overlay. data-testid='hero-section'
public_site.products_grid: Glassmorphism cards for gear. Filter and search bars with prominent dark inputs. data-testid='products-grid'
public_site.event_card: Bold imagery with a live countdown timer. High contrast red accents for urgency. data-testid='event-card'
public_site.pricing_card: Tiered packaging. Highlight the recommended package with a Gold or Red glowing border. data-testid='pricing-card'
public_site.contact_form: Shadcn input/textarea styled with dark surfaces and red focus rings. data-testid='contact-form'

admin_dashboard.sidebar: Solid dark surface #1A1A1A. Active links denoted by a striking red vertical accent line. data-testid='admin-sidebar'
admin_dashboard.metrics_cards: Bento grid style. Large typography for numbers. data-testid='metric-card'
admin_dashboard.data_table: Shadcn table customized for dark mode. Border-b only, no vertical lines. data-testid='data-table'
admin_dashboard.subscribers_crud: Profiles with physical progress tracking. Requires line charts (Recharts) for weight/measurements/fat%. Includes a grid gallery for before/after photos. data-testid='subscribers-crud'
admin_dashboard.payment_status: Strict color-coding badges mapped to the 'payment_status' color palette. data-testid='payment-badge'

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you inject 'Bebas Neue' and 'Manrope' fonts via Google Fonts in your index.html. Override Shadcn default border radius to be slightly sharper (e.g., max 4px to 8px). For standard UI elements, use Shadcn but apply the exact colors defined here. All interactive elements must carry 'data-testid' attributes. Apply glassmorphism accurately using tailwind utilities like 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10'. The admin panel must follow a Bento grid structure for metrics, utilizing a strict dark theme (#0A0A0A background, #1A1A1A for surfaces). Payment statuses must use precise color codes (Green/Yellow/Red) defined in the palette. Use Recharts for the physical progress tracking in the Subscriber CRUD.
